title.zh: HiRoute 新版本发布：新模型放心试，任务交给对的 Agent
title.en: New HiRoute Release: Try New Models Safely, Hand Tasks to the Right Agent

shortTitle.zh: 新版本发布：新模型放心试，任务交给对的 Agent
shortTitle.en: New release: try new models safely, hand tasks to the right Agent

description.zh: 在自己的工作里边用边评新模型，信任度按证据上调或下调；System One 每轮三问；路由计划绑定执行 Agent，和 Hermes 组成 Super Agent；Windows 桌面版首次发布，Linux 可以在浏览器里使用同一套界面。
description.en: Evaluate new models in your own work and adjust trust from evidence, ask three questions every turn with System One, bind execution Agents to routing plans for a Super Agent with Hermes, and use Windows Desktop or the same interface in a browser on Linux.

title.zh: 用 Hermes 和 HiRoute 搭一个 DeepSeek 式的 Super Agent
title.en: A DeepSeek-Style Super Agent with Hermes and HiRoute

shortTitle.zh: 用 Hermes 和 HiRoute 搭 Super Agent
shortTitle.en: A Super Agent with Hermes and HiRoute

description.zh: DeepSeek 提出了 Router 与 Worker 两层的 Super Agent 架构。用 Hermes 做 Router，HiRoute 按计划把任务交给 Pi、Qoder CLI、Codex CLI 等执行 Agent：提交即返回，结束时自动唤起，每一轮再按证据选模型。
description.en: DeepSeek described a two-layer Router and Worker architecture for a Super Agent. With Hermes as the Router, HiRoute hands each task to an execution Agent such as Pi, Qoder CLI or Codex CLI, returns on submit, wakes Hermes on completion and still picks a model for every turn.

title.zh: 切换模型会损失缓存，智能路由还省钱吗？
title.en: Switching Models Loses Cache, Not the Savings

shortTitle.zh: 模型切换、缓存与整单成本
shortTitle.en: Model switching, caching, and task cost

description.zh: 为什么切换模型丢掉的缓存抵不掉智能路由省下的钱：在 Astra 与 Qwen 3.8 Flash 实验中，就算缓存全部命中，省钱比例也只变化几个百分点。
description.en: Why the cache lost in a model switch does not cancel smart-routing savings: in the Astra and Qwen 3.8 Flash experiment, even a perfect cache changes the saving by only a few points.

title.zh: HiRoute 智能路由实战：GPT-6 Astra × Qwen-3.8 Flash，同等质量下成本降低 90%
title.en: HiRoute Smart Routing in Action: GPT-6 Astra × Qwen-3.8 Flash, Same Quality at 90% Lower Cost

shortTitle.zh: Astra × Qwen：同等质量，成本降低 90%
shortTitle.en: Astra × Qwen: same quality, 90% lower cost

description.zh: 用真实 Desktop 配置，看看 HiRoute 如何让 Qwen 做常规工作、Astra 接住关键决策：同等交付标准下降本超 90%，长任务还能依据执行表现自主切换模型。
description.en: See the real Desktop setup: Qwen handles routine work, Astra handles critical decisions. Over 90% lower cost at the same delivery standard, plus an unattended coding handoff.

title.zh: 让 AI Agent 更能干，让模型订阅更耐用：HiRoute 正式开源
title.en: HiRoute Is Open Source: Help Your Agents Do More and Your Subscriptions Go Further

description.zh: 从开源缘起、核心价值和真实实战，到三步上手与本地架构：了解 HiRoute 如何连接已有 Agent、模型与订阅，把主力能力留给关键工作。
description.en: Why we built HiRoute, what it delivers, and how to get started: connect your existing agents, models, and subscriptions, and reserve your strongest models for the work that needs them.
